answer: Capacity in this economy is tide, and it evaporates: every onyx loses half its tide each epoch and must re-buy it, where renewing the k-th onyx linked to one payer costs k² tide that epoch. The ocean logs the payer behind every renewal, so heads funded together pile onto one line and pay the curve. One honest onyx renews for 1 tide per epoch indefinitely; keeping 1,000 onyx alive from one treasury costs about 333 million tide every epoch, not once. The defence fails when payers can be split into unlinkable fronts cheaply.
